o.text: From Russian бензин (benzin), from German Benzin.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اورمق (urmaq), from Proto-Turkic *ur-. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰆𐰺 (ur-), Turkish vurmak, Uzbek urmak, etc.
The sense to multiply is a semantic loan from Arabic ضَرَبَ (ḍaraba, “to multiply”).
From Persian سحرکار (sehrkâr). By surface analysis, sehr + -kar.
